title: notopleura longipedunculata
intro: Notopleura longipedunculata, commonly known as the "Black Pepper Tree," is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help in the management of various diseases.
